orgs.name: ATLANTA LEGAL AID SOCIETY INC
services: Free civil legal help from the society's Cobb County office (30 South Park Sq, Marietta) - housing and eviction defense, benefits, family and consumer matters
Atlanta Legal Aid serves Clayton, Cobb, DeKalb, Fulton and Gwinnett counties; this record is its Cobb office (see also the Fulton and Gwinnett records for the same EIN)

orgs.name: COBB COUNTY BOARD OF COMMISSIONERS - CDBG PROGRAM OFFICE
services: Cobb County's designated Community Action Agency is the Board of Commissioners itself (per the Georgia CSBG state plan, DFCS) - there is no separate nonprofit CAP for Cobb; community-action functions run through county programs

The CDBG Program Office (192 Anderson St, Suite 150, Marietta) administers the county's federal CDBG, HOME and ESG grants; ESG funds homelessness prevention, rapid rehousing, emergency shelter and outreach through subrecipient providers

orgs.name: COBB HOMELESS ALLIANCE
services: Membership body of the Marietta/Cobb Continuum of Care (GA-506) - the coalition that coordinates the county's homeless response system, including the annual Point-in-Time count. It coordinates the system; it does not itself pay rent or run a shelter
The Center for Family Resources is the CoC's lead agency and runs Coordinated Entry (see its record in this batch)

orgs.name: FAMILY PROMISE OF COBB COUNTY
services: Eviction prevention, shelter and professional case management for families with children experiencing housing instability - in its own words, it helps families 'find a path back to safe, stable housing'
Essentials Pantry for its families, supported by congregations, volunteers and community partners
Offices at 1823 Blackwell Road, Marietta; its own site prints EIN 46-0531824, matching IRS BMF

orgs.name: LIVESAFE RESOURCES INC
services: The only domestic violence shelter in Cobb County (confidential location); 24-hour crisis line: 770-427-3390
The only sexual assault program serving Cobb, Cherokee and Paulding counties
Individual and group counseling, assistance obtaining Temporary Protective Orders, transitional housing and outreach advocacy - all services free to victims
orgs.serves: people impacted by domestic violence, sexual assault and elder abuse in Cobb, Cherokee and Paulding counties

orgs.name: MUST MINISTRIES INC

Rent and utility assistance and clothing for residents in need (per its services pages)
